Author: Gautam Chowdhary

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Cancellation Application No. - 88 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt. Nirotma Singh
Opposite Party :- State Of Up And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Kumar Dubey

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ashish Mishra,G.A.,Ravi Kumar Shukla,Vikash Chandra Tiwari Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, SriAshish Mishra, learned counsel for accused-opposite party no.2, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present anticipatory bail cancellation application has been moved seeking cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the accused-opposite party no.2 vide order dated 22.08.2023 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.2, Moradabad in Anticipatory Bail Application No.
2958 of 2023, (relating to Complaint Case No. 4435 of 2022), under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 406 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kundarki, District Moradabad.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Court No.2, Moradabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant-complainant states that this Hon'ble Court while granting anticipatory bail to the accused-opposite party no.2 did not consider the factual and legal aspect of Smt. Nirotma Singh vs State Of Up And Another on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54736953/
1

entities.text: Smt. Nirotma Singh vs State Of Up And Another on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that offence has been committed by the opposite party No.2 and therefore the anticipatory bail granted to the opposite party no.2 is liable to be cancelled.

Learned counsel further submits that the opposite party no.2 may misuse the liberty of bail and will not co-operate with the investigation/trial, thus the anticipatory bail granted to the accused-opposite party no.2 is liable to be cancelled.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the accused-opposite party no.2 states that the accused-opposite party no.2 is abiding with the conditions imposed upon him and further there is no illegality in the order impugned, thus the anticipatory bail cancellation application is liable to be rejected.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant could not point out any illegality in the order impugned as well as any ground to cancel the anticipatory bail to the applicant and the learned trial Court after considering the entire aspect of the matter had granted anticipatory bail to the accused-opposite party no.2 thus there is no illegality or perversity in the order impugned passed by the trial Court granting anticipatory bail.

6. Hon'ble Apex Court in case of Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694, has held that while deciding anticipatory bail, the Court must consider nature and gravity of accusation, antecedent of accused, possibility of accused to flee from justice and that Court must evaluate entire available material against the accused carefully and that the exact role of the accused has also to be taken into consideration.

entities.text: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra, (2011) 1 SCC 694
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. In the instant matter, the offence alleged is under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 406 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act.
Moreover, the trial Court while granting anticipatory bail to the opposite party no.2 have considered the nature and gravity of offence, antecedent of accused etc.
Therefore, no interference is warranted by this Court.
Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is bereft of merit and is rejected.

Order Date :- 7.7.2025 AS  Smt. Nirotma Singh vs State Of Up And Another on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/54736953/
